Needs changes before merge.

The local trial merge with upstream/main at d3e779907 was clean. I checked the current upstream AGENTS.md.

The shared profile helper preserves the previous collision calculation. The explicit-body preview test compares its bands with the collision stack. No golden files or snapshot PNGs change.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs:248`: Restore orbit control during placement. The view appears only when `pick != Off`. Its drag handler at line 320 requires `mode == Off`. Thus, the user cannot rotate the body in any visible state. Faces behind the body cannot be brought into view for a pick. Keep one preview at rest, but permit rotation during placement. Add a pointer-drag test that checks the view rotation.
2. PR body, `Screenshots`: Add viewable before and after images. The Windows temporary paths are not accessible to reviewers. Issue #2017 requires these images. Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not add them to this PR branch.

Local results:

- UI library test build: passed.
- UI library tests, run from `crates/ui`: 1,018 passed, 2 failed, 6 ignored. The tool preview and body tests passed.
- App suites: `machine_default_holder` 13 passed; `tool_body` 12 passed; `tool_body_bands` 13 passed; `tool_body_judged` 8 passed; `tool_body_view` 7 passed.
- Holder simulation suites: `sim_lathe_body` 5 passed; `sim_tool_body` 6 passed; `sim_tool_drawn_holder` 4 passed.
- Clippy for `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui`, with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The two UI failures are in unchanged tests. I did not run an upstream-only baseline, so their cause is not established:

```text
egui_app::tests::start_exit_viewport::picking_a_start_point_on_a_wall_regenerates_the_contour_and_undoes
crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/start_exit_viewport.rs:98
picked (60.000, 14.416) should match wall (60.000, 18.000)

egui_app::tests::start_exit_viewport::picking_an_exit_point_on_a_wall_applies_and_clear_restores_automatic_exit
crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/start_exit_viewport.rs:146
assertion failed: (draft.x - wall[0]).abs() < 0.5 && (draft.y - wall[1]).abs() < 0.5
```

Mutation checks: not run. The PR supplies no mutation cases. The collision calculation is an unchanged expression moved to a helper. This PR changes display behaviour, not the collision result, posted G-code, stock simulation or geometry. No goldens moved.

The PR remains a draft. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Orbit during placement: fixed locally in commit 8087f60cb6d9d43c8effca7a2527cc2c547f8e7d. `dragging_the_placement_preview_rotates_without_consuming_the_pick` checks tip and axis drags. Restoring the original guard fails the test. Restoring the fix passes. The quick gate against upstream/main and clippy for app/UI passed.
2. Screenshots: the PR body now embeds viewable before and after images. They are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at cede9911cb0e776e9020a77753d053f7b719057f. Both URLs return valid 1280×720 PNGs. The body check fails with the old temporary paths and passes with the new links.

The code push was blocked. Automatic approval review rejected `git push upstream HEAD:issue/2017-one-tool-preview` because policy forbids pushes to upstream. The local fix remains on branch `fix-2096`. The PR head is unchanged: 3e20c9eb42d4929abd31b3acad197cc49ebfe7aa.

Please re-review the screenshot update. The orbit fix needs a permitted push before code re-review. The PR remains a draft. No review labels were changed.

Addressed: head `fb13c716d158bce945c68b51df4a43b136d06301`.

The branch has a merge of `origin/main` (clean, no hand edits) and one fix commit.

What changed:

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs:328-334`: a drag on the 3D placement view now turns the view in each pick mode. The old guard `mode == BodyPickMode::Off` is removed. egui does not report a drag as a click, thus a drag does not use the armed pick. A plain click still picks. The view rotation is immediate-mode state, not a command.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_one_preview.rs:80-133`: new test `dragging_the_placement_preview_rotates_without_consuming_the_pick`. For "Pick tip" and "Pick axis", it drags with the pointer across the 3D view. It asserts that `yaw` and `pitch` changed, that the pick stays armed, and that the tip offset and the axis did not change. Then a plain click picks and ends the pick. The test asserts no position, size or colour. It finds the view from the live layout.

Gate results:

- Mutation check: with the old guard put back, the new test fails at `tool_one_preview.rs:117` (the rotation assert). With the fix, it passes.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 26 steps, 0 failed. `ui suites: lib`: 1203 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes up by one.
- `start_exit_viewport::picking_a_start_point_on_a_wall_regenerates_the_contour_and_undoes` and `start_exit_viewport::picking_an_exit_point_on_a_wall_applies_and_clear_restores_automatic_exit`: both pass on the merged branch (Windows, debug). I did not see the failures from the review.

Not exercised:

- I did not do a manual check in the GUI.
- The before and after screenshots in the PR body are older than this fix. The fix changes no drawing, thus the look must not change.

<!-- pr-reviewer: fb13c716d158bce945c68b51df4a43b136d06301 -->
**Verdict: ready**

Read from the diff. Not built. No test was run for this review.

## Scope A: the delta 3e20c9eb4..fb13c716d

- The merge commit 027890ad9 is clean. `git show --remerge-diff 027890ad9` is empty.
- The fix closes the finding of the last review. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs:328-335` removes the guard `mode == BodyPickMode::Off`. A drag now turns the 3D placement view in each pick mode.
- A drag does not fire a pick. The view uses `Sense::click_and_drag()`. egui reports `clicked()` only for a release inside the click distance and time. A drag that ends on the view is not a click. A press that moves less than the click distance is not `dragged()`, thus it picks and does not turn the view.
- The view rotation (`tool_body_ui.yaw`, `tool_body_ui.pitch`) stays immediate-mode state. No command is necessary.
- The new test `dragging_the_placement_preview_rotates_without_consuming_the_pick` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_one_preview.rs:92-133`) asserts behaviour: `yaw` and `pitch` change, the pick stays armed, `offset` and `axis` do not change, and a plain click then picks. With the old guard, `yaw` and `pitch` do not change, thus the assert at line 117 fails.

## Scope B: the full PR against main

- Everything Is a Command: the UI writes only view state (`yaw`, `pitch`, zoom). The pick path (`apply_body_pick`) is not changed by this PR.
- Layers: the UI calls only `camcraft_app::tool_body::checked_bands`. There is no `sys_*` call and no world call in the UI.
- One shape source: `checked_profile` (`crates/app/src/tool_body.rs:218-220`) replaces the inline floor in `judged`, and `checked_bands` (`:227-230`) sends that profile through `stack`. `envelope` (`tool_body_page.rs:37-55`) uses `checked_bands` in both branches. The UI has no second derivation. `the_side_preview_bands_are_the_collision_stack_of_an_explicit_body` compares the preview bands with `stack(judged profile)`.
- No snapshot PNG changes. No test is removed or ignored. The diff adds 5 `#[test]` functions in `crates/ui`, and `the_preview_zoom_clamps_and_fit_resets_it` now arms a pick first.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests.
- UI text: no new user string.
- Body: before and after images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, a `Changelog:` line, a decision file `docs/decisions/2017-one-tool-preview.md`, and a "Not exercised" section.

## Scope C

- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main fb13c716d` (origin/main e7f5f4315) has no conflict. GitHub shows `MERGEABLE`.

## Non-blockers

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_one_preview.rs:14-33` and `:81-89` find the previews by fill colour `rgb(24, 26, 31)` and by the rect sizes 260 x 260 and 260 x 200. The tests assert no colour or size, but a refit of the colour or the size breaks them. An AccessKit label on the two previews is a better locator. Follow-up `P7`.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_preview.rs:126-155` asserts the height-to-width ratio of the drawn holder. This is a to-scale check of the drawing, not a layout assert, and it agrees with the other tests in that file.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_body.rs` has 416 lines (413 on main). The PR adds 3 lines of `pub(super)`. A split is a follow-up.
4. Double-click to fit is now reachable only while a pick is armed, and the first click of a double-click picks and ends the pick. The "Fit" control of the body section still fits the view.
5. `layout_page_tool` is not changed. Its fixture has no body, thus the page layout at rest without a body does not change. The new test `the_tool_page_shows_one_preview_and_no_idle_3d_view` covers the body case.
6. The screenshots are older than the fix commit. The fix changes no drawing.

## Not checked

- No build, no test run, no clippy run, no mutation run for this review. The author's quick gate and mutation check (fix comment) are not repeated.
- The real app window and the lathe Body tab were not opened.
- The `needs-rework` label from the last review is still on the PR. This review changes no label.

Merge-time check. Class: **NEW CODE**, reviewed.

- The head is `fb13c716d158bce945c68b51df4a43b136d06301`. The review comment 6992602334 gives the verdict "ready" for this head. The reviewer did not write the change.
- The change request on `3e20c9eb4` had one code finding (no rotation during placement). The new head fixes it, and the test `dragging_the_placement_preview_rotates_without_consuming_the_pick` pins it.
- The author's quick gate is green on this head: 26 steps, `ui suites: lib` 1203 passed. Clippy for `camcraft-ui` is clean.
- The head merges with `main` without a refresh.

The PR is flagged ready now and merges pinned to this head. The `needs-rework` label is removed after the merge.

Clean review at this head.

The head adds one fix commit on a clean merge of main (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 2096 --reviewed 3e20c9eb4` says NEW CODE; the only hand change is `fb13c716d`). Both items of the earlier requested changes are resolved.

1. Orbit during placement: `preview_3d` now orbits on a drag in each pick mode (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs`). egui does not report a drag as a click, so the armed pick still waits for a plain click. The new test `dragging_the_placement_preview_rotates_without_consuming_the_pick` drags the view in each armed mode, checks the yaw and pitch change, checks the pick stays armed and nothing is picked, and checks a plain click still picks.
2. Screenshots: the body links viewable before and after images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. Both links return 200. The orbit fix changes pointer behaviour, which a still image cannot show; the drag test pins it.

Local results (built and tested on this head):

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1203 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. The two `start_exit_viewport` failures from the earlier head now pass; main's fix reached this head through the merge.
- The pinning test by exact name: passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Note for the merge batch: @mkinney mentioned a local fix `8087f60cb` for the same finding. That commit is not pushed to the fork. If it later lands and adds a test with the same name, one test must be dropped at merge time.

This PR is a draft. It obeys AGENTS.md; it changes display behaviour only, not posted G-code, simulation or geometry. A maintainer approves and merges by hand.
